name: Singapore Prison Service

scam_info.sample: Stay alert for fake websites copying MHA and Home Team agencies. Always verify that official sites end in .gov.sg, and report suspicious sites to Police via ScamShield at 1799.
scam_info.notes: Republication of the MHA 12 Aug 2026 advisory (>500 fake sites, none named). The only SPS scam item in its sitemap (224 URLs) or RSS. Search also shows the URL without /media/.

scam_info.sample: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 | Advisory On Fake Websites Impersonating MHA And Home Team Agencies
scam_info.notes: RSS 2.0 via rel=alternate: 135 items (25 Jan 2011 to 25 Nov 2026), 1 scam-related.

notes: Its site-wide banner says government officials will never ask for money, Singpass credentials or bank log-ins through unofficial channels. Search results also surfaced an ask.gov.sg SPS Q&A (https://ask.gov.sg/spsvco/...), which was not opened.
